quote.text:
If you still think Sol and Astra suck at design, try this:

“Use imagegen to reimagine this page, then implement it.”

Codex now has 𝗜𝗺𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀 𝟮.𝟲 built in, the strongest image model available today. Let it create the visuals first, then have Sol or Astra implement them.

Many of the 3D game scenes, characters, and animations shared in posts are built around this same approach.

If you only use Claude Code, this works there too: have Opus 5.5 call Codex through codex exec to generate the images, or call the API directly. ChatGPT Pro gives you $100 to $500 in API credits every month, so gpt-image-2.6 is basically free.
